🚀 SDXL 极简入门工作流合集

—— 删繁就简，只写底层节点

这是一套专门为SDXL新手打造的工作流合集。我秉持“极简”原则，尽可能减少了扩展节点的使用，并去掉了复杂的逻辑嵌套。旨在让每一位刚接触该模型的新手都能顺利跑通，并为后续的进阶学习打下清晰的基础。

—— Designed for Simplicity

📖 Description / 简介

[EN]This is a collection of essential workflows forSDXL. My goal was to create the most intuitive and clean experience possible. By minimizing the use of custom nodes and avoiding complex grouping, I’ve ensured that anyone new to this model can run it successfully and build a solid foundation for more advanced setups later.
